items.Sentence: In January 2014, the Discharger upgraded to the facility to include UV disinfection.
The Discharger has since discontinued the use of chlorine for disinfection purposes.
The Facility no longer discharges any water from the brine ponds into the wastewater system.
At the Facility, other than evaporation, the only known salts increase previously was due to chemical addition for chlorine disinfection and dechlorination (sodium hypochlorite and sodium bisulfate).
